unifiedMatrix.explanation: Per-script scoreline matrices merge by Match Script weights into one unified matrix. Every displayed prediction below is a marginal or cell aggregate of that matrix only.
derivationNotes: Winner probabilities sum home-win, draw, and away-win cells in the unified matrix.
Most likely scoreline 3-3 is the highest-probability cell.
Goal range buckets aggregate total-goals mass from the same matrix.
BTTS Yes sums all cells where both teams score at least once.
Over 2.5 sums all cells with three or more total goals; Under 2.5 is the complement.
